# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite backend and memory safety**

## Highlights

This upcoming release adds the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel reads, and closes several native memory-safety issues. New Graphite bindings bring Skia's next-generation rendering engine to .NET for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. Multiple native use-after-free bugs and a pixel-buffer leak are fixed. Hot-path allocations are reduced across SKData, GetEncodedText, and the uniform uniform-map. WASM gains .NET 11 support via Emscripten 5.0.6.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Upstream chrome/m151 stability fixes** — Multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs applied, including upstream stability improvements and cgmanifest updates. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — Full C# bindings for Skia's next-generation Graphite rendering backend are now available, enabling hardware-accelerated rendering via Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn on supported platforms. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels for SKImage and SKSurface** — A new async pixel-read API lets callers request pixel data from any GPU backend without stalling the GPU pipeline. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — A new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET convenience package wires up Silk.NET Vulkan interop so consumers can create a GRContext with minimal boilerplate. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Containerized test targets: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — CI now validates SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Windows Nano Server, and these targets are included in the shipped native asset set. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* fixed** — The pixel-source SKBitmap or SKData could be collected before the derived SKPixmap finished using it; the root object is now kept alive for the lifetime of the pixmap. ([#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Native use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator fixed** — The parent SKRegion could be garbage-collected mid-iteration; it is now rooted for the iterator's lifetime. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path fixed** — When native raster image creation failed, the unmanaged pixel buffer was not freed; the leak is now closed. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Binding generation is now deterministic across platforms** — The P/Invoke binding generator produces bit-identical output regardless of the build machine OS, eliminating spurious diffs in generated files. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))
- **SKData.SaveTo double-copy eliminated** — SKData.SaveTo previously copied data into an intermediate buffer before writing; it now writes directly, halving peak memory use for large payloads. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **Hot-path allocation reductions** — HandleDictionary skip-registration check is cached; the null-terminated GetEncodedText path no longer allocates an intermediate string; SKRuntimeEffectUniforms map is pre-sized. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **WASM .NET 11 support via Emscripten 5.0.6** — New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries with the new exnref exception-handling ABI are included, enabling SkiaSharp on .NET 11 WASM. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))
- **Windows native build MSVC environment initialized once** — The MSVC toolchain environment is now set up once per native build invocation instead of per-target, reducing build time on Windows. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))
- **FreeType font support for Windows Nano Server** — Nano Server now uses FreeType for font rendering, giving text-layout workloads a working font engine on that platform. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
